strongest_results.result: A rich rigid-motion bound and two exact point-line models force n^(9/20-o(1)) structured-plane concentration in the glide and fixed-point branches.
strongest_results.boundary: The capacity gap is n^(3/20), the reflection branch remains, and no original exponent changed; OPEN.

strongest_results.result: The primitive odd-prime two-support branch has an iff signed-residue histogram classification; finite-prime marginal constraints admit simultaneous CRT realizations.
strongest_results.boundary: No universal bridge to arbitrary exponent multisets; OPEN.

strongest_results.boundary: The cores and the full t=2 problem are not excluded; OPEN.
